entities.summary: Juan Andres Guzmán Correa is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher who played ten seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB). He spent most of his playing career with the Toronto Blue Jays and was part of their World Series winning teams in 1992 and 1993.

entities.summary: Juan Andres Guzmán Correa is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher who played ten seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB). He spent most of his playing career with the Toronto Blue Jays and was part of their World Series winning teams in 1992 and 1993.
